plan.output: A concise narration outline for one operator supplied monthly review deck, with each statement linked to a supplied slide or figure.
inputs: A fictional or operator supplied review deck with non-sensitive figures
A chosen audience such as team, investors, or clients
A short list of approved company and brand terms
plan.trigger: The operator supplies a deck and selects the intended audience for a monthly review.
steps: Read the supplied deck and identify its headings and figures.
Draft a short narration outline in the selected audience tone.
Attach each factual sentence to a slide heading or figure.
Flag unsupported statements or missing context for review.
Return the outline for a person to correct and approve.
plan.acceptanceCheck: On a fictional deck, verify every numeric statement matches its cited slide and every unsupported conclusion is flagged rather than added.
plan.humanBoundary: The operator supplies a sanitized deck, confirms its figures and audience, and approves all narration; this experiment does not render or send a video.
unverified: Reliable extraction from varied slide layouts
Whether the monthly task occurs across enough independent buyers
Any paid demand for an AI narration service

limitations: Reliable extraction from varied slide layouts
Whether the monthly task occurs across enough independent buyers
Any paid demand for an AI narration service

plan.output: One reviewable wireframe draft from an operator supplied rough sketch, with uncertain elements marked for manual correction.
inputs: A synthetic rough interface sketch with no personal or client information
A short operator supplied description of the intended screen and its main controls
A chosen output format such as a labeled screen image or wireframe description
plan.trigger: An operator supplies one rough sketch and a brief description of what the screen should communicate.
steps: Record the supplied sketch and brief as one test case.
Ask a proposed image-capable model to produce a clearer wireframe draft.
Compare the draft with the stated controls and layout intent.
Mark ambiguous or invented elements for correction rather than treating them as requirements.
Return the draft and uncertainty notes for a designer to review and edit.
plan.acceptanceCheck: For a small set of synthetic sketches with labeled intended controls, check whether each control appears in the draft and whether ambiguous details are marked for review.
plan.humanBoundary: The operator supplies permitted sketches and intent notes; a designer checks visual fidelity, corrects the draft, and decides whether it is usable. No editor integration or real-time transformation is proposed as an established capability.

Whether professional designers or service firms have repeated demand or would pay
